history.content: Organize a dinner with Dana, Priya, Marcus and Tom sometime next week.

Want me to send that to all four, or do you already know a night that works so I can skip the round trip?

Noted, Dana's out Thursday and Friday. That leaves Monday through Wednesday plus the weekend as options so far.

Any word from Priya, Marcus, or Tom yet, or should I nudge them?
Everyone else is good with Wednesday 7:30. Let's do it.

Both are staged, nothing sent yet.

You'll see a review card for the calendar invite and the email to the four of them. Tap approve on each and they go out.

While that's pending: want me to line up a restaurant for Wednesday 7:30? Just say the vibe or neighborhood.
Yes send the invite to everyone.

The email to the four of them didn't go through on my end just now. Easiest fix: once the invite is approved, it'll land in their inboxes as an invite anyway, or I can retry the email if you want the note too.
